newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Montclair, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Montclair, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Director of Finance of the Township of Montclair at 205 Claremont Avenue, Montclair, N.J. on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Township dated February 1, 1997 and due (subject to prior redemption) on January 1 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

2002505,000 The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be entitled to the benefits of the New Jersey School Bond Reserve Act, P.L. 1980, C.72. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, New Jersey.

The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on January 1 and July 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on July 1, 1997. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Robert E. Orosz, the Director of Finance at 205 Claremont Avenue, Monclair, N.J. 07042, (201) 509-4964.
